dogecoin.text: @tonfish_tg Meme coins are cryptocurrencies that often gain popularity through internet culture, memes, and social media buzz rather than intrinsic technological value. Some of the most well-known examples include Dogecoin (DOGE) and Shiba Inu (SHIB).
